## Core Insight — D025 Pivot
Symbolic constraint consensus doesn't improve LLM reasoning — not because the idea is wrong, but because of a **capability trap**: the method needs output diversity (disagreement to resolve) AND high constraint quality (to resolve it correctly). These two conditions are inversely correlated in practice — models produce diverse outputs on hard tasks, but generate low-quality constraints on those same hard tasks.
